title: JEPAhead: From Inpainting to Causal Forecasting for Urban Driving
abstract: arXiv:2611.08657v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We fine-tune a pre-trained V-JEPA1 predictor from bidirectional latent inpainting to action-free causal forecasting while keeping the encoder frozen. Using contiguous past observations, horizon-aligned targets, and group-level causal attention, the model forecasts eight future token groups, corresponding to sixteen frames, in one forward pass. On CARLA Town12, it retrieves the correct future among 591 candidates in 69.0% of cases, compared with 55.3% for persistence, with greater gains at longer horizons and on tokens exhibiting greater change. It also outperforms a compact predictor trained from scratch with six times fewer parameters. Semantic analysis indicates driving-relevant information in predicted features: a fixed linear probe trained on real encoder tokens achieves 0.16 mIoU on patches undergoing semantic-class changes, versus 0.13 for persistence. Vehicle-conditioned retrieval improves over persistence by 15 percenta

translated_title: JEPAhead：从潜空间修复到城市驾驶因果预测
translated_abstract: 我们对预训练的 V-JEPA1 预测器进行微调，将其从双向潜空间修复任务转变为无动作因果预测，同时保持编码器冻结。利用连续的过去观测、视界对齐的目标以及组级因果注意力，该模型可在一次前向传播中预测八个未来 token 组（对应十六帧）。在 CARLA Town12 上，该模型在 69.0% 的案例中能够从 591 个候选中检索出正确的未来，而持续性基线仅为 55.3%，且在更长的时间视界以及变化更大的 token 上收益更为显著。它还以六分之一的参数量优于从零开始训练的紧凑预测器。语义分析表明，预测特征中包含与驾驶相关的信息：在真实编码器 token 上训练的固定线性探针，在发生语义类别变化的图像块上达到 0.16 mIoU，而持续性方法仅为 0.13。以车辆为条件的检索比持续性方法提升了 15 个百分点。
tldr: 该研究将预训练 V-JEPA1 预测器从潜空间修复微调为无动作因果预测，可在一次前向传播中预测十六帧未来场景，在城市驾驶预测任务上显著优于持续性基线且参数效率更高。
en_tdlr: This work fine-tunes a pre-trained V-JEPA1 predictor from latent inpainting to action-free causal forecasting, predicting sixteen future frames in a single forward pass and substantially outperforming persistence on urban driving forecasting with greater parameter efficiency.
